profile.headline: Senior Member Of Technical Staff at Salesforce

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
RailsBridge is a nonprofit organization dedicated to keeping the Ruby and Rails communities friendly, vibrant, and welcoming to people of all backgrounds. We run introductory Ruby on Rails (as well as front-end and mobile) workshops aimed at under-represented groups.

After taking all RailsBridge curriculum, I am now volunteering as a teacher assistant/instructor for the Ruby on Rails path and front-end JavaScript, HTML/CSS path.

positions.title: Support Engineer - Onboarding Lead
positions.description:
FiveStars is the fastest growing company in customer loyalty and marketing automation for local businesses. Launched out of Y-Combinator three years ago to democratize Fortune 500-level loyalty technology, we now drive two million customer visits per month across our network of over five thousand businesses and have raised a total of $45 million in funding from top-tier investors like Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed, and DCM.

I was responsible for building out the Operations' internal Knowledge Base by writing technical documentation on FiveStars software, hardware and internal tools, how to troubleshoot, and archiving new processes so that all team members had a cohesive method of looking up solutions and information.
I developed curriculum and on-boarded new hires within 2 weeks through one-on-one trainings and providing feedback on troubleshooting, best practices, and product knowledge.
I was the point person for writing SQL queries for customers and the technical support team.
I heavily troubleshot POS, Mac OS X, scanners, and tablets when the FiveStars software was down and documented issues on the SFDC platform and Desk.com
Being a fluent Spanish speaker in Operations, I handled all on-call responsibilities of Account Managers and Cancellation Representatives, as well as translated on-boarding materials and presentation decks and executed the presentations and trainings in Spanish.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
Hackbright Academy is the leading engineering school for women with a mission to increase female representation in tech through education, mentorship and community. The curriculum teaches full stack software engineering using Python, Flask, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL and ORMs, HTML/CSS, and git.

For a list of projects, you can view my GitHub profile: https://github.com/Rosy-S

company.name: UC Berkeley IT Student Computer Consulting Services

positions.title: SCCS IT Consultant
positions.description: I provided frontline customer support to students, faculty and staff across multiple platforms with installing and troubleshooting technical problems with Adobe and MS Office Suite, BeSecure antivirus, Cisco VPN, proxy network setup, and Windows 8. I also offered networking support of iOS, Android, and Blackberry devices, and helped clients configure and connect to Calmail email system. I diagnosed modem and network configuration issues with on-campus networks (DHCP, Airbears, Airbears2). I worked with other SCCS IT Consultants in compiling information and writing documentation for the SCCS database to service future SCCS IT consultants. When technical problems could not be solved, I researched client questions to find solutions and followed up via email and phone calls.

positions.title: Function Lead
positions.description: I supervised a team of four Computer Consultants concerning company work ethics; customer service; on-shift responsibilities; and technical skills in Microsoft, Adobe, and facility hardware. This was done through administering tests for technical skill and policy knowledge, conducting one-on-one meetings and training, and writing mid-semester and final evaluations for each team member. Additionally, I collaborated with management supervisors and the senior team to improve facilities and client services through weekly meetings where we created project agendas and discussed potential improvements in IT service for the UC Berkeley computer labs. I also administered interviews for both Function Lead promotions and Computer Consultant new-hires, as well as oversaw the application development and interview process for Webcast Operational Staff team. After the hiring process, I oversaw the Webcast Operational Staff team through writing training and documentation materials, training team members on video trimming/publishing process, and planning schedule to deliver over 150 webcasts weekly to UC Berkeley staff and faculty.

positions.title: Computer Consultant
positions.description: Provided front-line customer service and troubleshooting for clients in MS Office Suite, Adobe Programs, and network printing across nine campus computer facilities. Responsible for the maintenance and overseeing of equipment, supplies, and workspace at various computer facilities for a client base of over 25,000 students and faculty.  Worked on a team to re-design curriculum for technical workshops to improve the quality and cohesion of classes and presented ideas to senior team and department supervisors. After I was promoted to Function Lead, I continued to maintain all of these additional responsibilities.

positions.title: Care Provider
positions.description:
Helped two physically impaired UC Berkeley students with feeding, cleaning, showering, dressing, and other daily tasks. Followed specific instructions, depending on clients’ needs. Used
medical equipment and followed medical protocol for caring for people with physical limitations. Remained on call in case of emergencies and accidents.

company.name: Alameda County In Home Support Services

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: The position held started as a volunteer position, which progressed to an employed student worker after 6 months of volunteering. Used library databases and informational systems to locate required information and materials for customers, staff, and the Inter-library Loan Program. Helped chaperone library community events for children, teenagers, and adults. Completed other tasks as assigned.
